existing_statement: This implementation is exact, non-parametric, and correctly accounts for multi-seed correlation... It guarantees exact nominal Type I error control (alpha = 0.05) regardless of intra-cluster correlation.
evidence_analysis: Sign-flip permutation exactness requires conditional reflection symmetry under the sharp null hypothesis (d_i and -d_i equally likely). In ML benchmarking, models are evaluated deterministically without randomized treatment allocation. Under error asymmetry/skewness across recording clusters, the test is asymptotically valid, not finite-sample exact.
recommended_correction: State that exact Type I error control requires the sharp exchangeability null H_0^sharp: (y_i^E2, y_i^E3) =d= (y_i^E3, y_i^E2). Note that under asymmetric error distributions, permutation validity relies on asymptotic normality.

existing_statement: Unit of Analysis: Physical recording cluster.
evidence_analysis: Averaging seed outcomes over a 10s audio clip accounts for within-clip seed correlation, but if multiple 10s clips originate from the same continuous Freesound upload or recording session, treating them as independent units violates cluster independence.
recommended_correction: Enforce cluster grouping by root physical recording ID (recording_id) across all sampling and evaluation scripts, guaranteeing that no two test clips share an acoustic source or upload session.
